Refs #396. Acceptance needs a release and a live pi-action thread, so this PR doesn't close the issue.

## What it does

After every run that answers, pi-durable hosts collapse the tool calls of older finished runs into one deterministic line each. No model call is involved. The line is written in the same `afterRun` write that applies the ed

ops:
Since collapse.ts is untracked, I need to use listChangedFiles to make sure it's included rather than relying on the diff stat alone. I'm also noting the behavior change where existing threads already over 32K will collapse immediately on next run, and that the hook now creates a task every run on durable hosts—both seem acceptable to proceed with.

I'll draft the PR body covering defaults, strict-provider results, tests, and mutation probes, referencing issue #396.
